nuggets.text: Kicker Nico Gramatica is the son of Martin Gramatica, the Buccaneers' Super Bowl-winning kicker nicknamed Automatica.
Nico Gramatica followed uncles Bill and Santiago Gramatica as kickers for the Bulls, and his mom Ashlee played tennis at USF.
Nico Gramatica drilled four field goals, including a 53-yarder, in the Bulls' 19-9 opening win over FIU.
Nico Gramatica made the game-winning kick when the Bulls beat Florida last season.
Brian Hartline coached five first-round receivers at Ohio State, including Marvin Harrison Jr. and Garrett Wilson.
The Bulls' trip to Army is the earliest conference game in program history.
The Bulls' new on-campus stadium is billed as having the largest rooftop bar in Florida.
The Bulls held their first-ever team meeting in 1997 under a shade tree because the school had no football facilities.
This is the Bulls' 30th season of football and their last at Raymond James Stadium before an on-campus stadium opens in 2027.
The Bulls' last trip to West Point, in 2003, ended in a 28-0 win.
